frozen_note: A rules file is never edited once a pick has been made under it. A rule change is a NEW file (rules_v3.json), a new hound_version, and a one-line change to config/gematria/active.json. Past picks keep the version they were made under.
origin: Rules v1 with three changes, all calibrated on PICK RATE (picks per day on stored boards) and on nothing else; no win or loss was consulted (research/rabbitszn/METHOD.md, 'Rules v2: pre-registration'). (1) static_fallback: a game whose season counts are thin, or whose sport has no stored results, is scored on the static evidence of each team (cipher values, statehood, date numbers, founding spans) instead of passing. (2) name_only_teams: a team the facts layer does not hold is read by its name alone. (3) the margin must clear a floor AND be min_z times the game's own noise (the square root of the summed squared weights of every match on both sides), instead of a fixed 3.0; picks are ranked by that z and the day is capped at max_picks_per_day. The weights of the three new static kinds copy their nearest v1 analogue (a date match is 1.0, a self-agreement between two facts of one team 0.5, 33/47 1.0).
